Extract Log-Likelihood

logLik.xpose_data.Rd

See stats::logLik() for use

Usage

# S3 method for class 'xpose_data'
logLik(object, ...)

# S3 method for class '`NULL`'
logLik(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'logical'
logLik(object, ...)

# S3 method for class '`try-error`'
logLik(object, ...)

Arguments

object

any object from which a log-likelihood value, or a contribution to a log-likelihood value, can be extracted.

...

some methods for this generic function require additional arguments.

Value

a logLik object

Functions

  • logLik(`NULL`): logLik for NULL returns an NA object

  • logLik(logical): logLik for NA returns an NA object

  • logLik(`try-error`): logLik for try-error returns an NA object

See also

NA_logLik_
